newsitem.title: FINLAND: PARTEK JAN-APR EARNINGS SEEN IN WIDE RANGE.
newsitem.headline: PARTEK JAN-APR EARNINGS SEEN IN WIDE RANGE.

text.p: Analysts' forecast for Finnish building materials and cargo handling equipment group Partek Oy Ab's January-April profit before extraordinary items and tax were in a range from nil to 126 million markka.
Some of the seven analysts who participated in the poll said the changes that have occurred in the group structure made it very difficult to make an accurate forecast.
Partek's four-month results are due on June 13 at 0900/0600 GMT. In January-April 1996, Partek posted a profit before extraordinaries and tax of 9.2 million markka.

In January this year, Partek announced it would merge with state-owned engineering group Sisu Oy. It said the merger would take place step-by-step and that Sisu would be incorporated at the end of April.

Last year, Partek's structure underwent a number of smaller changes as its minerals business expanded through acquisitions, parts of its insulation operations were divested, some half-owned pre-cast concrete businesses were merged and other pre-cast concrete units sold and the Cargotec division's activities and structure were reorganised.
Five analysts' forecasts for Partek's full-year 1997 profit before extras and tax were in a 290-570 million markka range.
In 1996, Partek's profit was 226 million markka.
Contributors to the survey were Alfred Berg, Aros Securities, Carnegie, Evli Securities, Erik Selin, FSB Securities, Merita Securities and Opstock Securities.
